question: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie).
sql:
WITH rep_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        wr.region_id,
        wr.name as rep_name,
        COUNT(*) as rep_order_count,
        SUM(wo.total_amt_usd) as rep_total_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wr.region_id ORDER BY SUM(wo.total_amt_usd) DESC, wr.name ASC) as rn
    FROM web_orders wo
    JOIN web_accounts wa ON wo.account_id = wa.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps wr ON wa.sales_rep_id = wr.id
    WHERE wr.region_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY wr.region_id, wr.name
),
region_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        region_id,
        COUNT(*) as region_order_count,
        SUM(rep_total_sales) as region_total_sales
    FROM rep_sales
    GROUP BY region_id
),
max_sales_per_region AS (
    SELECT 
        region_id,
        MAX(rep_total_sales) as max_rep_sales
    FROM rep_sales
    GROUP BY region_id
),
top_reps AS (
    SELECT 
        rs.region_id,
        rs.rep_name,
        rs.rep_order_count,
        rs.rep_total_sales
    FROM rep_sales rs
    JOIN max_sales_per_region msp ON rs.region_id = msp.region_id AND rs.rep_total_sales = msp.max_rep_sales
)
SELECT 
    rt.region_id,
    rt.region_order_count as order_count,
    rt.region_total_sales as total_sales,
    tr.rep_name,
    tr.rep_total_sales as rep_sales_amount
FROM region_totals rt
JOIN max_sales_per_region msp ON rt.region_id = msp.region_id
JOIN top_reps tr ON rt.region_id = tr.region_id
ORDER BY rt.region_id, tr.rep_total_sales DESC
